owner: Government of Vanuatu (funded by Australian Government)
notes: Second of two data centres funded by Australia (combined value A$120m/US$79m) under the Nakamal Agreement, located on the island of Santo (Espiritu Santo, Sanma province). Vanuatu government announced the pair in 2024 as part of an e-commerce/digital economy strategy; agreement initialled 13 Aug 2025 and signed 29 Jun 2026. Details sparse; no public MW capacity.
